# Data

The list of numbers the page charts.

- **values** is the list of numbers, in the order they should appear from left
  to right. Each becomes one bar; negative numbers hang below the zero line.
  At least one and at most 1000.
- **title** is the page's title, printed as its heading. It defaults to
  "Chart".

For example:

```yaml
title: Weekly signups
values: [12, 18, 9, 24, 31, 27]
```
